The workbook's statistics calculations are failing with #NAME? errors in the output cells.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed because cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected numeric values. This error typically indicates that the Excel formulas used in the workbook are invalid, reference non-existent names, or use functions not supported by the evaluator. Specific failing cells include H46 (expected -2.7657), I46 (expected -2.4125), and H47 (expected 1.2553), all of which returned #NAME?.
